# Data Source: identitynow_sod_policy

Use this data source to look up a separation of duties (SOD) policy by ID or name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "identitynow_sod_policy" "payables_receivables" {
  name = "Payables vs Receivables"
}
```

Exactly one of `id` and `name` must be set.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) SOD policy ID. Exactly one of `id` and `name` must be set.
- `name` (String) SOD policy name. Exactly one of `id` and `name` must be set.

### Read-Only

- `compensating_controls` (String) Compensating (mitigating) controls.
- `conflicting_access_criteria_json` (String) Conflicting access criteria as a JSON object.
- `correction_advice` (String) Advice on how to correct a violation.
- `created` (String) Creation date.
- `creator_id` (String) ID of the identity that created the policy.
- `description` (String) Policy description.
- `external_policy_reference` (String) Reference to an external policy.
- `modified` (String) Last modification date.
- `modifier_id` (String) ID of the identity that last modified the policy.
- `owner_ref` (Attributes List) Owner of the policy, with `id`, `type` and `name`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--owner_ref))
- `policy_query` (String) Search query of the policy.
- `scheduled` (Boolean) Whether the policy is scheduled.
- `state` (String) Whether the policy is `ENFORCED` or `NOT_ENFORCED`.
- `tags` (List of String) Tags of the policy.
- `type` (String) Policy type, `GENERAL` or `CONFLICTING_ACCESS_BASED`.
- `violation_owner_assignment_config` (Attributes List) Who owns the violations of the policy, with `assignment_rule` and `owner_ref` (`id`, `type` and `name`). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--violation_owner_assignment_config))

<a id="nestedatt--owner_ref"></a>
### Nested Schema for `owner_ref`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Owner ID.
- `name` (String) Owner name.
- `type` (String) Owner type.


<a id="nestedatt--violation_owner_assignment_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `violation_owner_assignment_config`

Read-Only:

- `assignment_rule` (String) Violation owner assignment rule, `MANAGER` or `STATIC`.
- `owner_ref` (Attributes List) Owner of the violations for the `STATIC` rule. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--violation_owner_assignment_config--owner_ref))

<a id="nestedatt--violation_owner_assignment_config--owner_ref"></a>
### Nested Schema for `violation_owner_assignment_config.owner_ref`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Owner ID.
- `name` (String) Owner name.
- `type` (String) Owner type.
